channel.title: NBC Sports Fantasy Football News
channel.description: Latest player news and analysis for fantasy football from NBC Sports.

item.title: Carson Beck (back) did not practice on Wednesday.
item.description: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur said Beck has been steadily improving since back spasms hit him late in Thursday’s practice. The team is taking it one day at a time with him. The team is preparing to start Josh Johnson in Week 12 against the Commanders this week.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Cardinals claimed QB Kedon Slovis off waivers.
item.description: The former Raven is now a Cardinal. He was notably on Arizona’s roster last summer. Slovis could end up taking live reps, pending Carson Beck’s (back) health and Josh Johnson’s performance, but he would only be a QB2/3 in that instance.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Chargers claimed CB Avery Smith off waivers.
item.description: The Chargers traded Smith to the Seahawks earlier this year. The Seahawks waived him on Tuesday. Whether Smith plays meaningful snaps remains to be seen, but he is familiar with the system.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Juwan Johnson (hamstring) was not seen practicing on Wednesday.
item.description: Johnson is unlikely to play in Week 12 against the Bengals at this point. The Saints’ No. 1 tight end injured his hamstring last week. Recovering in one week is a tall task for a player who needs to be able to stride while running routes.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Taliese Fuaga (knee) was seen practicing on Wednesday.
item.description: Fuaga, the Saints’ right tackle, and C Erik McCoy (biceps) were both practicing on Wednesday. This is great news for the offense overall. Getting both players back would be helpful this week against the Bengals’ talented defensive line.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Jakobi Meyers (ankle) was limited on Wednesday.
item.description: Meyers has been dealing with this ankle issue for weeks now, but it has not impacted his game-day availability. Meyers is FLEX-viable against a soft Titans pass defense in Week 12.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Carnell Tate (shoulder) is practicing in full for Week 12 against the Jaguars.
item.description: Tate returned from his multi-week absence last week, posting a 2/58/1 receiving line. He faces the Jaguars’ capable defense in Week 12, but his role and talent keep him in the WR3 tier. Tate looks like a classic rookie wide receiver set to produce late in the season.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Abdul Carter (ankle/calf) did not practice on Wednesday.
item.description: Carter is firmly in the questionable camp for the Giants’ Week 12 game against the lowly Colts. Giants LB Arvell Reese (back) was limited at today’s practice. Hopefully, one or both of them are good to go this weekend.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Isaiah Williams (ribs) was limited in Wednesday’s practice.
item.description: Williams missed last week with the rib issue. Omar Cooper was also out, allowing Sterling Shepard to take over the No. 3 receiver role. Shepard saw two targets and managed to get into the end zone on both of them. Cooper appears to be out again this week, but Williams is trending in the right direction. Needless to say, we can’t recommend Shepard (or Williams) in fantasy leagues this week.-Kyle Dvorchak

item.title: Isaiah Likely (groin) was limited on Wednesday.
item.description: Likely injured his groin during practice last week and caught just one pass for 35 yards on Sunday against the Jaguars. His early-week participation is a good sign for his overall health. He will be in the TE1 ranks this week against the Colts.-Nic Bodiford
